overview: A rain sensor is two parts: a flat board printed with a grid of exposed parallel copper traces, and a small comparator board (again, usually LM393-based) that reads it. Water bridging the gaps between traces lowers the resistance across the board, which the comparator converts into both an analog 'how wet' signal and a digital 'wet or not' threshold. It's essentially the same resistive-sensing principle as the soil moisture sensor, just laid out flat to catch falling rain instead of being pushed into soil, and it shares the same corrosion consideration — the exposed copper traces will oxidize over prolonged exposure to moisture.
simpleSummary: A flat sensor board that detects water on its surface, so it can trigger an alert when it rains.

specifications.sensingBoard: Exposed parallel copper traces — resistance drops as more of the grid is bridged by water
specifications.durabilityNote: Copper traces corrode with prolonged exposure — not a permanent outdoor sensor without maintenance or a coated variant

pinMap.name: VCC
pinMap.function: Power input to the comparator board.

pinMap.name: AOUT
pinMap.function: Analog output, varies with how much of the sensing grid is wet.

pinMap.name: DOUT
pinMap.function: Digital threshold output, adjustable via the onboard trimpot.
pinMap.gotcha: The exposed copper grid corrodes over repeated wet/dry cycles outdoors — expect to eventually clean or replace the sensing board on long-term installations.

useCases.title: Automatic window/skylight closer
useCases.scenario: Trigger a servo or actuator to close a window when rain is detected.

useCases.title: Smart irrigation skip logic
useCases.scenario: Skip a scheduled watering cycle if rain is already detected.

useCases.title: Weather station rain gauge (binary)
useCases.scenario: Log rain events over time, though without measuring precise rainfall volume.

oftenConfusedWith: Soil moisture sensor (same sensing principle, different physical layout/application)
oftenUpgradedTo: Tipping-bucket rain gauges for actual rainfall volume measurement
